|lore='''Leader''' of a Tusken Raider tribe. Unafraid of machines. Skilled hunter and marksman. Raids moisture farms for water. Roams the Jundland Wastes in search of unwary travelers.
|game_text=Deploys only on Tatooine. Once per turn, may place a card from hand on top of your Force Pile to draw top card of Reserve Deck. While on Tatooine, opponent’s weapon destiny draws here are -2. Tuskens are forfeit +4 here.
|errata_history=Versions of [[URoRRuR'R'R (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]], in date order (3 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): release sheet “Virtual Set #8” (Players Committee; released 24 November 2004; PDF dated 24 November 2004), page 3, slip 46 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205113015/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualSet8Final.pdf VirtualSet8Final.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 5 December 2004), announced in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news post of 24 November 2004]: “Deploys only on Tatooine. Once per turn, may place a card from hand on top of your Force Pile to draw top card of Reserve Deck. While on Tatooine, opponent’s weapon destiny draws here are -2. Tuskens are forfeit +4 here.” Stats line: “POWER 2 ABILITY 1”. Deploy 2, forfeit 5. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “8•46” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[URoRRuR'R'R (V) (Virtual Set 8) (Errata)]]): a post by Kevin Brownell (“CubsFan”), the Committee's Marketing & Player Relations Advocate in the Committee's forum thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (“official rulings and errata issued by the Rules Committee”), 9 November 2005 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20060617231905/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=4438 Internet Archive capture of 17 June 2006]): “Effective immediately, these five virtual cards are being errata'd as follows:” “Deploys only on Tatooine. While another Tusken here, opponent's weapon destiny draws here are -2 and once per turn, may place a card from hand on top of your Force Pile to draw top card of Reserve Deck. Other Tuskens here are forfeit +4.” Stats line in the post: “POWER: 2 ABILITY: 1” and “DEPLOY: 3 FORFEIT: 4”. The post gives the text only (no slip image). '''What changed:''' the errata rewrote the text (full text above).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[URoRRuR'R'R (V) (Virtual Set 8) (Errata 2)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards8.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007; later 2007 re-edits included], slip 46), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploys only on Tatooine. While with another Tusken Raider: opponent’s weapon destiny draws here are -2; once per turn, may place a card from hand on Force Pile to draw top card of Reserve Deck; and other Tusken Raiders here are forfeit +4.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
